name: News headlines
description: Reads the news feeds you add (RSS or Atom) and gives the latest headlines: title, source, time and link. It comes with no feeds, does not fetch or summarize articles, and each feed's site on the internet needs its own Yes before it loads.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.add_feed: Add a news feed (an RSS or Atom address) with a short name. The bot raises a Yes card for its site and port, and its headlines load after the owner's Yes. Adding a feed already on the list asks again.
tools.remove_feed: Remove a news feed by its name or address.
tools.list_feeds: List the news feeds that have been added, with their addresses.
tools.headlines: The latest news headlines from the added feeds, or from one feed: title, source, time and link. No article text.

add_feed: add the news feed at https://www.example.org/news/rss.xml and call it Local Paper
remove_feed: remove the Local Paper news feed
list_feeds: which news feeds do I have
headlines: give me five headlines from Local Paper

consent: News headlines keeps your feed list and the last headlines it read in its own data folder on this computer. It uses the internet only to fetch the feeds you add. Each feed's site on the internet needs its own Yes, and it sends those sites nothing about you except a plain request for the feed (like any web request, they see your home's internet address).
